config.moduleName: Nordic Ebony Armor and Weapons Replacer

plugin.name: ESP version (recommended)
plugin.description: A light plugin (ESL-flagged, it takes no load-order slot) that points vanilla's four ebony armour addon records at this mod's own mesh folder and gives the helmet the open-helm body slots. Nothing else is needed. Ryn's Snazzy Last Vigil's Ebony Warrior set and the Ebony Mail keep their own look with this option.

plugin.name: No ESP - SkyPatcher
plugin.description: No plugin at all. REQUIRES SkyPatcher (https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/106659), which edits records at game start from text files. The armour and weapons show the same look and keep their stats: the worn meshes sit on vanilla's own ebony paths, and SkyPatcher gives the helmet the open-helm body slots so the head is not hidden. With this option SkyPatcher also gives the Ebony Mail and, if Ryn's Snazzy Last Vigil is installed, the Ebony Warrior's and the Vitreous Ebony set this look (Ryn's scimitar stays his). What changes against the ESP version: any other mod that replaces the vanilla ebony armour meshes wins or loses by mod order instead of being ignored; the helmet no longer takes the Head slot, so a head-slot item can be worn with it; and the CBBE 3BA and HIMBO body fits (prebuilt meshes and BodySlide output) go into the ESP version's mesh folder, so with this option the armour keeps its vanilla-body fit.

plugin.name: With the fur collar
plugin.description: The cuirass as NordwarUA built it, with the fur mantle across the shoulders - in black, recoloured from his own fur.

plugin.name: Without the fur collar
plugin.description: NordwarUA's collarless version of the same cuirass. Nothing else changes.

plugin.name: CBBE 3BA - BodySlide files
plugin.description: Slider sets and shape data to build the female set to your CBBE 3BA preset in BodySlide (no physics), from Xonek's Legacy of Ysgramor - 3BA Bodyslide (permissions as Legacy of Ysgramor's), under the group "Nordic Ebony - CBBE 3BA". Nothing is prebuilt: build them once in BodySlide.
